summary_en: This study tests SIM0500, given alone, in adults with relapsed or refractory multiple myeloma. SIM0500 is given in 28-day cycles until disease progression, intolerable toxicity, withdrawal from treatment, or end of study, and the method of administration is not stated. The study evaluates safety and tolerability, efficacy, and pharmacokinetics, and it is a Phase 1 trial.
summary_es: Este estudio evalúa SIM0500, administrado solo, en adultos con mieloma múltiple recidivante o refractario. SIM0500 se administra en ciclos de 28 días hasta la progresión de la enfermedad, toxicidad intolerable, retiro del tratamiento o fin del estudio, y el método de administración no está indicado. El estudio evalúa la seguridad y tolerabilidad, la eficacia y la farmacocinética, y es un ensayo de Fase 1.
who_for: Documented relapsed or refractory multiple myeloma per IMWG criteria, after failing all established standard of care.
Life expectancy of at least 12 weeks.
Adequate blood, liver, and kidney function.
not_for: Active hepatitis B or hepatitis C infection.
Pregnant, breastfeeding, or planning to conceive or father a child during the trial.
Active or suspected autoimmune disease, with some listed exceptions.
Other cancer within 3 years, with listed exceptions.
